notes: Pole-mounted LED area light sold as a one-for-one replacement for 70 to 400 W HID heads. The MVOLT (120-277 V) driver is described; HVOLT (347-480 V) and XVOLT (277-480 V) drivers are other voltage options, with some limits on options.

gaps: Lumens conflict: the introduction says 7,000 to 17,000 lumens, while the performance table runs from 6,313 (P1, R4S, 30K) to 17,242 (P4, R5S, 50K). Lumens are not a rating field, so none are claimed.
Driver maker and model are not named on the sheet, so none is claimed.
Fuse ratings and holder location are not given, so only the SF and DF options are claimed.
Acuity's own product pages were not readable (HTTP 403 on the lithonia.acuitybrands.com page); the copy read is Rev. 10/09/24, so the current revision may differ.
method: Spec sheet 'Lithonia RSX1 Area LED', Rev. 10/09/24 (pages 1-9 of a 28-page PDF; the later pages are other Acuity sheets and were not used), read with node tools/research.js pdf; pages 1 and 2 rendered and checked against the text.
Page 1: weight and ordering tree. Page 2: notes and accessories. Page 4: lumens and system watts. Pages 5-8: weight by mounting type. Page 9: features and specifications.

The copy is on an Azure file store (epcdevplanstorage.blob.core.windows.net), not on acuitybrands.com; the pages carry the Lithonia Lighting logo, 'Lithonia RSX1 Area LED', the Acuity Brands copyright and the revision.

comps.spec: High-efficacy LEDs on metal-core circuit boards with aluminium heat sinks; light engines IP66 rated; lumen maintenance above L92 at 100,000 h. System watts by package: 51 W (P1), 72 W (P2), 109 W (P3), 133 W (P4); 3000K, 4000K or 5000K, 70 CRI minimum.
Precision acrylic refractive lenses in Type 2, 3, 3S, 4, 4S, 5 and 5S distributions and AFR (automotive front row), including the rotated AFRR90 and AFRL90.

Class 1 electronic LED driver, 0-10 V dimming as standard. The MVOLT driver runs on any line voltage from 120-277 V at 50/60 Hz; HVOLT (347-480 V) and XVOLT (277-480 V) drivers are other options. System power factor above 90%, THD below 20%.
Surge protection device, 10 kV as standard, meeting at least Category C Low per ANSI/IEEE C62.41.2; the SPD20KV option is a 20 kV surge pack.

Photocontrol options: PE button-style photocell (needs MVOLT or 347 V), or PER7 seven-wire twist-lock receptacle only. Twist-lock photocells are ordered separately: DLL127F 1.5 JU (120-277 V), DLL347F 1.5 CUL JU (347 V), DLL480F 1.5 CUL JU (480 V); shorting cap DSHORT SBK U.
Optional fusing: single fuse (SF) for 120, 277 or 347 V, or double fuse (DF) for 208, 240 or 480 V. Not available with XVOLT.

Rugged die-cast aluminium main body with heat-dissipating fins and flow-through venting, TGIC thermoset powder-coated. Luminaire weight 22.0 lb (10.0 kg) with the SPA mount; the sheet's weights by mounting type run up to 31 lb (AAWSC).
